subject.title: fix(discord): resolve named agent delivery targets

question: Should agent delivery adopt this shared strict preflight for every plugin with an authoritative target resolver, or should the fix remain narrowly Discord-scoped through the alternative PR?
rationale: Both implementations address the reproduced Discord bug, but this branch also establishes a cross-plugin fail-closed contract and changes when invalid targets stop a run; that compatibility boundary requires explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Adopt shared strict preflight
options.body: Land this implementation after refreshing it onto current main, making authoritative target resolution and canonical recovery state the generic agent-delivery contract.

options.title: Narrow to Discord
options.body: Limit strict name-to-ID handling to Discord and preserve the existing generic agent-delivery fallback semantics for other plugins.

options.title: Prefer the alternative PR
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107934 as the canonical fix and close this branch only after confirming that its narrower implementation covers best-effort delivery and recovery state.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared strict preflight
recommendation.body: Land this implementation after refreshing it onto current main, making authoritative target resolution and canonical recovery state the generic agent-delivery contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged history spans both the agent delivery runtime and Discord resolver seams where the contract choice must be maintained.
